title: Privacy Policy
text:
Use of Personal Information

Vape Shop Australia collects personal information when you buy vapes online Australia to process orders, deliver products, and provide customer support. This includes details such as your name, email address, phone number, and delivery information. All information collected is used solely to operate our online vape store Australia efficiently and improve customer experience. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties, ensuring your privacy is always protected when purchasing disposable vapes, vape kits, vape pods, e-liquids, nicotine vapes, and other vape products online Australia.

Data Protection and Security

We take customer security seriously. Vape Shop Australia uses industry-standard security measures, including encrypted payment gateways and secure servers, to protect your personal and payment information. While we strive to maintain the highest level of security, no system is completely foolproof. By using our website and buying vapes online Australia, you acknowledge and accept these measures and agree to the terms of this privacy policy.

Third-Party Services

To provide efficient services and fast vape delivery Australia-wide, we may share limited customer information with trusted third-party providers such as payment processors, shipping partners, or e-commerce platforms. These third parties receive only the necessary information to perform their services and are bound by strict privacy agreements. Your data is never used for marketing purposes without consent.

Customer Rights and Access

Customers have the right to access, update, or request deletion of their personal information held by Vape Shop Australia. Requests can be made via our customer support team. We strive to respond promptly and ensure all personal information is accurate, secure, and handled according to Australian privacy laws and regulations.

Policy Updates and Acceptance

Vape Shop Australia reserves the right to update or modify this privacy policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page, and continued use of the website or purchase of vapes online Australia constitutes acceptance of the updated policy. We encourage all customers to review this privacy policy regularly to stay informed about how their data is protected and used.
